question.text: Under Section 15HAA, what acts regarding electronic databases of SEBI attract penalties?

answer.text: Introducing computer virus or contaminant into the system database causing trading halt

All of: introducing a computer virus or contaminant causing a trading halt; unauthorized access or modification of access parameters to the regulatory database; unauthorized downloading, extraction or copying of regulatory data
Unauthorized access or modification of access parameters to the regulatory database
Unauthorized downloading, extraction, copying of regulatory data from the system database

explanation.text: The Logic: Section 15HAA covers unauthorized access/modification of access parameters, unauthorized downloading/copying of data, introducing computer viruses causing trading halts, unauthorized disruption of database functioning, and knowingly damaging/destroying regulatory data. The Trap: Each listed act is a separate offence, but the section covers every one of them comprehensively. Cross-Exam Context: Cyber security related penalties are an emerging topic in NISM certifications. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Implement robust access controls for all SEBI-related systems - unauthorized access alone (even without data theft) is punishable.
